units.source_text: 他回想多年以前的事，觉得此人十分可爱，情不自禁，只得写这封信去。

en.t: He thought back to events from many years before and found this person so endearing that he could not restrain his feelings, and so he had no choice but to write and send this letter.

units.source_text: 筑紫的五节舞姬收到了信，也不胜怀旧，深感人世无常。

en.t: When the Gosechi dancer from Tsukushi received the letter, she too was overcome with memories of the past and deeply felt the impermanence of human life.
